effect_evidence.note: Frozen independent effect evidence for the Chaos `successful_full_loop` dimension. The prediction is bound to the ActionType the replay builds; the authoritative observation comes from a source that never receives the executor receipt, so closure cannot be satisfied by dispatch success. The negative cases are the fail-closed evidence classes: missing, stale, incomplete, conflicting, and not-yet-recorded.

negative_cases.note: No authoritative observation was produced before closure was attempted.
The only observation arrived after the prediction's observation deadline.
The observation does not cover the predicted metric, so the evidence set is incomplete.
The authoritative observation contradicts the prediction it is correlated to.

The observation carries a value the prediction accepts and a time inside the effect window, but a time later than the moment the comparison is recorded on the replay timeline, so it has not happened yet from the recorder's point of view and cannot be scored.

note: Chaos recovery-observation precondition: a recovery-plan postgresql-server with no diagnostic settings has no attestable log-plane trail, so the recovery plan's own change-safety objective is unmeasurable until diagnostics are attached. Props fire ONLY diagnostic-settings-required; ha_mode=ZoneRedundant, encryption_at_rest_enabled=true, ssl_enforcement=enabled, backup_retention_days=35, and cpu_p95_percent=80 satisfy the co-resident postgresql rules so the citing set stays single-rule. `remediate.enable-diagnostic-settings` declares a `static_enum` blast radius and an `enforce_auto` t0 ceiling, so the shadow executor genuinely publishes one remediation PR, matching should_execute=true.
